note: Original one-line glosses written for this project. Not copied from the AMA CPT book or any payer. If a code is not listed here, Callsheet abstains from explaining it.

99213.label: Office visit, established patient
99213.gloss: A routine visit for someone already known to the provider.

85025.label: Complete blood count
85025.gloss: A common blood test that counts red cells, white cells, and platelets.

80053.label: Comprehensive metabolic panel
80053.gloss: A blood test that checks sugar, electrolytes, kidney, and liver values.

71046.label: Chest X-ray, 2 views
71046.gloss: Two pictures of the chest, usually front and side.
